verdict.rationale: Fathom documents registrable outbound webhooks that POST meeting data (summary, transcript, action items, CRM matches) to a user-chosen URL. They can be created and deleted via the API or in the UI (Manage > Add Webhook), are signed with signature headers, and come with a verify_webhook SDK helper. They are included on all plans. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documentation of event types beyond new meeting content (the event selection is limited to meeting-content payloads).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks will send your meeting data (optionally including the summary, transcript, and action items) to a URL of your choice.
Create a webhook to receive new meeting content.
Each webhook request sent from Fathom includes a signature in the request headers, which you can use to confirm the authenticity of the payload.
API access—keys and webhooks— are included on all plans.
